states.title: Preview
states.consequence: Rendered product preview is the active media view.

states.title: Code
states.consequence: Implementation/code content is the active media view.

states.title: Files
states.consequence: Downloadable/source-file content is the active media view.

states.title: Ready
states.consequence: The current checkout step accepts input and the next action remains available.

states.title: Processing
states.consequence: The current checkout mutation is in flight and repeat submission is blocked.

states.title: Failed
states.consequence: Checkout context is preserved and the failed step exposes a recovery path.

states.title: Recovered
states.consequence: The blocking checkout issue is resolved and the user can continue from preserved context.

states.title: Payment failed
states.consequence: The provider rejected or failed the payment; quote and customer context remain available for recovery.

states.title: Payment recovered
states.consequence: Payment details or method are valid again; the preserved quote can be reviewed and resubmitted.

states.title: Processing
states.consequence: Submission is pending; duplicate mutation is blocked and motion respects reduced-motion preferences.

states.title: Active
states.consequence: The license is currently valid under its normalized ownership rules.

states.title: Grace
states.consequence: A temporary recovery window is active; the UI must explain what remains available and for how long.

states.title: Expired
states.consequence: The active entitlement window has ended; renewal or purchase recovery may be required.

states.title: Cancelled
states.consequence: The license is cancelled according to provider/policy data; do not imply active rights.

states.title: Refunded
states.consequence: The transaction was refunded; entitlement consequences follow normalized policy/provider results.

states.title: Eligible
states.consequence: Current entitlement permits updates and signed downloads.

states.title: Grace eligibility
states.consequence: Temporary access may remain during the recovery window; state the exact consequence returned by policy.

states.title: Not eligible
states.consequence: The update/download entitlement has expired; explain the renewal or recovery path.

states.title: Renewal active
states.consequence: Renewal is active and the next billing or entitlement date stays visible.

states.title: Renewal grace
states.consequence: Renewal recovery is available during a defined grace period.

states.title: Renewal expired
states.consequence: The renewal entitlement window ended; the UI must not imply ongoing eligibility.

states.title: Renewal cancelled
states.consequence: Renewal is cancelled; any remaining paid-term access must be represented separately.

states.title: Past due
states.consequence: Billing recovery is required while entitlement consequences remain separately explicit.

states.title: Ready to quote
states.consequence: A target plan/effective date can be selected; no mutation has happened.

states.title: Quoted
states.consequence: Provider-authoritative price/capacity consequences are visible before confirmation.

states.title: Applying change
states.consequence: The plan mutation is in flight and duplicate submission is blocked.

states.title: Change complete
states.consequence: The provider confirmed the plan change; normalized license/entitlement data can now refresh.

states.title: Change failed
states.consequence: The current plan remains authoritative and a recoverable error path is exposed.

states.title: Ready to invite
states.consequence: Recipient/type can be entered; ownership has not moved.

states.title: Creating invitation
states.consequence: The invitation mutation is pending; current ownership remains unchanged.

states.title: Invitation created
states.consequence: A transfer invitation exists, but ownership changes only when provider data confirms completion.

states.title: Invitation failed
states.consequence: No ownership transfer occurred; preserve current ownership and expose recovery.

states.title: Subscription active
states.consequence: Renewal is active and the next billing date remains visible.

states.title: Cancels at term end
states.consequence: Renewal is disabled while paid-term access remains available through the provider-returned end date.

states.title: Subscription cancelled
states.consequence: The subscription is no longer active; entitlement state must still be represented separately.

states.title: Subscription past due
states.consequence: Billing recovery is required; do not collapse this into license or entitlement status.

states.title: Empty
states.consequence: There is no content yet; provide the next meaningful action when one exists.

states.title: Loading
states.consequence: Data is pending; preserve layout context and respect reduced motion.

states.title: Error
states.consequence: A request failed; keep user context and expose a recovery action when possible.

states.title: Offline
states.consequence: Network access is unavailable; preserve local/user context and explain what can still be done.

states.title: Permission required
states.consequence: The user lacks required access; explain the permission boundary and next step.

states.title: Unsupported
states.consequence: The requested capability is unavailable in the current environment/provider; offer a supported alternative when possible.
